name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena
log: I got the mirror from Sera, who was doing her laundry, and took it to Heena.

name: Returning to Nina
log: You told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.

name: Lucas's Reply
log: Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. Now I want to read it too. Wonder what this was all about...

name: Mai's Final Training
log: Mai believes that, while understanding my abilities is important, challenging myself with stronger monsters is also a great training method. She asked me to defeat 1 Orange Mushroom. An Orange Mushroom...? They seem really strong. Can I really defeat one?

name: Midnight Rest Quest
log: Midnight Rest Quest

name: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life
log: After easily passing the test Trainer Bartos of Henesys gave me, I got a hold of the Water of Life and Life Scroll and got them to Mar the Fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now... Sweet...

name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror
log: I met Heena, who's worried the sun is damaging her skin. I should get her mirror from her sister, Sera, so she can check.

name: Roger's Apple
log: Press the hotkey I to open your inventory, navigate to the Use tab, and double-click Roger's Apple to consume it. Then, talk to Roger.

name: What Sen wants to eat
log: Nina is wondering what to make her brother, Sen, for dinner. Go talk to Sen, who's in the house next to Nina, and ask him what he wants to eat.

name: Todd's How-to-Hunt
log: Todd asked me to defeat Tutorial Jr. Sentinels, then talk to Peter.

name: Sam's Suggestion
log: Sam told me to head east and hunt 10 Snails before meeting up with Mai.

name: Letter for Lucas
log: Maria needs help. She asked me to deliver a letter to Lucas in Amherst.

name: Mai's Training
log: I am now under the tutelage of the famous sword master, Mai, in A Split Road. For my first lesson, she told me to hunt Blue Snails, Shrooms, and Red Snails. Ah, Mai also said to meet up with Biggs in Southperry for a useful quest.

name: Biggs's Collection of Items
log: I met Biggs in Southperry. He wants me to get him 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells. He seemed pretty skeptical that I'd be able to do it, but it sounds like a piece of cake to me!

name: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods
log: I ran into Pio, who's famous in Amherst for fixing broken things. He asked me to break down wooden boxes from around town and bring back Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards.

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 1
log: I'm not a total newbie anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 2
log: What's Rain's second question?

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 3
log: Time for Rain's third question.

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 4
log: I can answer Rain's questions if I think carefully enough.

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 5
log: What's the fifth question?

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6
log: And next, the sixth question.

name: Rain's Maple Quiz 7
log: Finally, the last question. After this, I'll be a true Mapler.

name: Olaf's First Training
log: I met Olaf at Lith Harbor. Olaf mentioned that I could get a job advancement once I reach level 10, but he wasn't sure if I truly have what it takes. To prove myself, Olaf told me to hunt monsters outside the village. I'm a bit nervous, since the monsters on Victoria Island seem really strong...

name: Phil's Call
log: Phil, the informant of Lith Harbor, explained that once you reach Level 10, you can make a job advancement in each town of Victoria Island. They asked me to help out the townsfolk in Lith Harbor and hunt monsters to reach Level 10, then return.

name: Olaf's Second Training
log: I saw Olaf again in Lith Harbor. He said my training is still far from over and gave me a mission to hunt stronger monsters, farther from town. Once I finish this training, will I finally become a true adventurer?

name: Teo's Weird Hobby
log: Teo in Lith Harbor told me his hobby is collecting weird things. He asked me to hunt Slimes near the town and bring back 1 Slime Bubble. He warned me that it might be hard to find, though!

name: Teo's Even Weirder Hobby
log: Teo in Lith Harbor asked me for even weirder items to complete his collection. He said he absolutely NEEDS an intact Pig's Head... Why is he even collecting this kind of stuff?

name: [Event] Gift for the New Journey
log: I've obtained the Gift for the New Journey. It should come in handy for my future adventures.

name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
log: I met Bruce, who's been studying the monsters and animals around Henesys. His bright smile and easygoing demeanor belie the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time now. The reason he's been studying the mushroom monsters is to uncover clues as to his daughter's whereabouts. He asked if I could help him out, and I just couldn't say no to such a worthy cause...

name: I Need Help on My Homework!
log: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I'd expect from someone asking for a FAVOR. Well, he asked me to get him 10 Leafs, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles. They're ingredients for a potion he was assigned to make for homework.

name: Don Hwang's Request
log: I paid Nella a commission of 1,000 mesos in exchange for her bringing me various jobs and requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is from Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials for crafting new armor. I need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs, and collect 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons. It shouldn't be too hard, since Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs are easy to find near Kerning City.

name: Shumi's Request
log: I delivered what Shumi asked for and got a bunch of Cakes in return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has his own house. Return to Nella for another gig.

name: Andre's Request
log: I delivered what Andre asked for and got a glove in return. I hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. Return to Nella for another gig.

name: The Stump Horror Story
log: I met Ayan in Perion. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the Stumps that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of Stumps, Ayan can't take a single step out of Perion, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary?

name: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
log: The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, is giving me a test to see if I'm fit to become his apprentice. He said that a true blacksmith must have the required amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to defeat the monsters around Perion and bring back the raw ore they drop.

name: Mr. Thunder�in Need of an Apprentice
log: Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said that weapon crafting requires one to have the proper amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to use my Smithing skill to craft 1 Bronze Ingot and 1 Iron Ingot. As long as I have the materials, those shouldn't be too difficult to make.

name: Francois in Need of an Apprentice
log: After I told Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, that I want to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He told me tailoring requires one to have the right balance of skill and knowledge and asked me to defeat monsters near Ellinia and collect Leafs.

name: Vicious in Need of an Apprentice
log: After I told Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, that I wanted to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He said that woodcrafting requires one to have the proper strength and knowledge and asked me to defeat monsters near Henesys and collect Tree Branches.

name: JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner
log: The leatherworking master, JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City, is giving me a test to see if I'm worthy of becoming his partner. He said that one must have the proper strength and knowledge for leatherworking and asked me to defeat monsters around Kerning City and Henesys to collect Leather.

name: Chrishrama in Need of an Apprentice
log: The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, gave me a test after I asked to become his apprentice. He said true Arcforgers must possess great wisdom and instructed me to defeat monsters around Sleepywood and collect 1 Garnet Ore.

name: [Event] A Strange and Familiar Wood
log: Take the Strange Mushroom Spore from Arwen the Fairy to Grendel the Really Old for analysis. Then, talk to Arwen the Fairy again.

name: [Event] Gathering Leaves
log: I need to collect the mysterious letters dropped by monsters level 10 and above, such as Ribbon Pig, Dark Stump, Octopus, and Green Mushroom. I can exchange them with the Maple Administrator in Henesys for a gift that'll help me in my adventure...

name: [Event] Growing Leaf
log: Hold on to your Pale Maple Leaf and stay online for 60 minutes. As time passes, the leaf will slowly turn into a Reddened Maple Leaf. Keep playing and let it grow! If you lost the leaf, forfeit the quest to receive another one.

name: [Event] Halloween Candies
log: Malady in Henesys and Kerning City has had her stash of Halloween Candies carried off by monsters. Halloween Candies dropped by monsters level 10 and above, such as Ribbon Pig, Dark Stump, Octopus, and Green Mushroom.\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] Trick or Treat!
log: Malady has split her Halloween Candy into three pouches for the children spending Halloween alone. Deliver a pouch to the child in the dark tunnel, the child on the open field and the child up on the high ground.\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] Founder's First Step
log: Today's gift have been claimed. Claim all 14 rewards and your first step will be complete.

name: [Event] The Journey Begins
log: To celebrate the Grand Launch, the Maple Administrator is handing out gifts. A Maple Leaf might be dropped by monsters Lv. 10 and above. Bring them to the Maple Administrator in exchange for a gift.\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
log: I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news; he finally found his daughter!! There's one problem, however... She is suffering from amnesia! Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter liked to play with growing up and asked me to deliver it to her.

name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
log: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from her amnesia with the help of her toy sword. It was amazing! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally reunite. But first, I have to get this letter from Ayan back to Bruce.

name: I'm Bored 1
log: I went to talk to Icarus in Kerning City. What exactly was he doing, staring aimlessly at the sky? He seemed really bored and asked me if I'd answer his questions.

name: I'm Bored 2
log: I answered all of Icarus's questions. But he still seemed bored out of his mind; he asked me if I'd bring him a toy to play with.

name: Fixing Blackbull's House
log: In the dusty town of Perion, I ran into a man named Blackbull. He needs to fix his house and asked if I could help him out by defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps and getting him 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no? I won't be... BANISHED from the village... will I? I really hope not...

name: Make a Match Cards Set
log: I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting if I brought him enough Monster Cards. Getting them should be easy. I just have to defeat any of the following monsters, scattered across Maple World: Blue Snail, Pig, Ribbon Pig, Octopus, Blue Mushroom, Horny Mushroom, Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Lupin, Cold Eye, Lorang, Tortie, Wraith, Drake, or Wild Kargo. I should try to gather them when I have time.

name: Make a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set
log: I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting and asked me to collect a few items. He said I can get them by defeating Stump, Slime, and Orange Mushroom, found around Henesys. I should try to gather them when I have the time.

name: Make a Slime & Pig Omok Set
log: Casey in Henesys Park said he could make a new type of Omok Set if I brought him a few items. He said I can easily get them by defeating Stump, Slime, and Pig, found around Henesys. I should try to gather them when I have the time.

name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms
log: Shane in Ellinia wants to eat a delicious mushroom dish and asked me to find some ingredients for him. He said that Green Mushroom Caps are a favorite of his, so I should head out and hunt Green Mushrooms near the forest.

name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
log: Shane in Ellinia said he learned of an even better way to cook Green Mushroom Caps and asked me to bring some Green Mushroom Caps, as well as a Lemon.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry
log: I ran into Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys, who seemed overcome with worry. She told me that they were short on decorations for the village festival and asked me to get 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry
log: I saw Mrs. Ming Ming again in Henesys; she's still preparing for the village carnival. She said that this time she needs food for the carnival and asked me to collect 10 Pig's Heads, 30 Octopus Legs, and Estelle's Special Sauce. To get the Special Sauce, I think I'll have to go find Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia.

name: Estelle's Request
log: I got 1 Garnet for Estelle, who I met near The Field South of Ellinia, for making her mother's birthday present. She gave me Estelle's Special Sauce. I better collect the other materials and return to Mrs. Ming Ming.

name: Estelle's Special Sauce
log: I got all the materials that Mrs. Ming Ming asked me to get and gave them to her. I can't wait to see the village carnival!

name: Silas Irons in Need of Help
log: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request, but he's been struggling because he's short on materials. I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot to help him out.

name: Mr. Thunder in Need of Help
log: Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, received an important request, but he's been having trouble because he's short on materials. I'll need to defeat some Axe Stumps and craft 10 Screws to help him out.

name: Francois in Need of Help
log: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. I need to defeat Green Mushrooms and craft 10 Spool of Thread to help him out.

name: Vicious in Need of Help
log: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him out, I need to defeat Axe Stumps and craft 1 Processed Wood.

name: JM From tha Streetz in Need of Help
log: The leatherworking master, JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him, I'll need to defeat Jr. Neckis and gather Jr. Necki Skins.

name: Chrishrama in Need of Help
log: The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, received an important research request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. I'll need to defeat Green Mushrooms and gather 10 Fragment of Magic to help him out.

name: [Event] Beyond the Unknown
log: I need to head to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North to find the bizarre cave entrance and investigate its surroundings for Arwen the Fairy.

name: [Event] The One Who Sealed the Darkness
log: Grendel the Really Old is worried that there might be a problem with the World Tree and asked me to talk to Manji in Perion about it.

name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom
log: Under the watchtower in Henesys Park, I saw Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She told me that she ran into a bully Blue Mushroom on her way to Ellinia, and now she wants me to show the rude mushroom who's boss! I need to collect 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps to show her as evidence. I contemplated telling Pia she's basically asking to be teased, wandering around the forest in a teddy bear costume like that, but I decided against it.

name: Searching for Fossils
log: Winston, an archaeologist I ran into in the Rocky Mountains east of Perion, has lost the fossils he's meticulously been collecting in the region. He asked me to bring back 12 Animal Fossils and 12 Plant Fossils, which have been stolen by Green Mushrooms and Axe Stumps. How could he lose such important things? He's more careless than he looks...

name: Delivering a Box of Fossils
log: Winston the archaeologist has realized that it's not the best idea to leave such valuable fossils in a tent. He asked me to deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia for safekeeping. He also wrote me a letter of introduction to show her.

name: Research on Plant Fossils
log: Dr. Betty asked me to help out as her assistant for a bit. My first task is to collect 8 Plant Samples. I can see a lot of plants covering the woods in Ellinia.

name: Research on Animal Fossils
log: Dr. Betty in Ellinia needs 1 Stuffed Drake Skull for her research. She asked me to fetch one from her daughter, who should be near Henesys. But where exactly would Anne be...?

name: Transporting Drake's Skull
log: I got the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne, Dr. Betty's daughter. Now, to deliver this VERY CAREFULLY to Dr. Betty...

name: Progress on Fossil Research
log: I visited Dr. Betty again. She finally completed her research and asked if I could take the final report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I were to take 20 Leafs, 15 pieces of Firewood, 1 Stump's Teardrop, and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings, it'd make Dr. Winston very happy.

name: Bruce's Dilemma
log: Bruce, your neighbor living in Henesys, has been agonizing over how to get his newly found daughter, Ayan, to open her heart to him. It might be best to seek advice from Mrs. Ming Ming. \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Advice
log: Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys advised that it is crucial for Bruce to convey his true feelings to his daughter, and suggested that preparing a homemade dish for her would be a great idea. Since Bruce isn't good at cooking, she asked me to deliver a recipe for a dish that Ayan would love.\r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Bruce's Cooking Ingredients
log: It seems Bruce in Henesys needs ingredients to make a dish according to Mrs. Ming Ming's Cooking Recipe. You need to bring him the ingredients by defeating monsters or buying them from the town's general store.\r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Father's Love for His Daughter
log: Bruce in Henesys asked me to deliver his homemade Bruce's Special Cake to Ayan in Perion. It would be better if he delivered it himself, but... I can understand him being shy. \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.�

name: The Best Dad
log: After eating her dad's food, I think Ayan in Perion came to understand his true feelings. She then asked me to convey her feelings to Bruce in Henesys. \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.

name: The Right to Own a Home
log: Arthur of Henesys Town Hall said he had some good news, and told me that I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find Tommy.

name: Looking for a House
log: Tommy of Henesys Town Hall suggested that if I want to get a house, I should go see Bianca. I should be able to find Bianca on the east side of Henesys.

name: Stirge Phobia
log: It seems like Jake, who works at the subway entrance in Kerning City, needs Mong from Kong's help to cure his fear of Stirge. I should ask Mong from Kong in Kerning City if there is a good way. \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.�

name: Making the Medicine
log: I have my doubts about whether Mong from Kong in Kerning City truly knows anything about Stirge, but as he says, I should look for the materials needed to craft the medicine. I need to defeat Bubbling and Stirge around Kerning City and collect 10 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and 10 Stirge Wings.\r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.�

name: The Final Ingredient for the Cure
log: Claiming that he needs the final ingredient for the Stirge phobia cure, Mong from Kong in Kerning City asked me to go get a Vitamin Gummy from his grandfather, Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor. To think that Mr. Goldstein was Mong from Kong's grandfather... \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.�

name: Grandfather's Vitamin Gummy
log: I obtained the final ingredient for the Stirge phobia cure, the Vitamin Gummy, from Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor. Now, all I need to do is bring this to Mong from Kong in Kerning City. \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.�

name: It's All in the Mind
log: I need to deliver the Special Stirge Phobia Cure crafted by Mong from Kong to Jake at the subway entrance in Kerning City. I hope this helps... \r Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.�

name: The Right to Own a Home
log: Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center said in an excited voice that she had good news, and told me I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find Jack.

name: Looking for a House
log: Jack of Kerning City Civic Center gruffly told me that if I wanted a house, I should go see Scarlett. I should be able to find Scarlett in the center of Kerning City.

name: Alex's Request
log: On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex, who's run away from home because of a fight with his father, Chief Stan, in Henesys. But Alex is exhausted from being on the run and is out of money. He wants to go home and try to work things out with his strict, but admittedly loving, father. He asked me if I could persuade his father to not punish him for what he did. Also, he wants me to bring the Old Gold Watch his mother left him when she died, as proof that he really did have his father's forgiveness.

name: Talking to Stan
log: Only after I brought the Green Mushroom Caps and Blue Mushroom Caps did Chief Stan start talking to me.

name: Mother's Gold Watch
log: I gave Alex his late mother's Old Gold Watch. As a sign of appreciation, he gave me an earring he received from friends he met while traveling. Well, Chief Stan forgave Alex, but it doesn't seem like Alex plans to head home right away. Maybe I should keep an eye open next time I'm in Henesys.

name: Luke the Security Guy
log: At the Dungeon Entrance, I met Luke, the guard. He told me that he wanted to make a nourishing snack for his mother and asked me to hunt 20 Jr. Neckis and 20 Stirges and bring back 10 Jr. Necki Skins, 10 Stirge Wings, and 1 Salad. He said he's too busy with his guard duties to do it himself... but, honestly, he looks like he's sleeping on the job!!

name: Jane and the Mushroom
log: I met a girl wearing bunny ears named Jane in Lith Harbor. Jane said she wants to travel the world, but her dad won't let her. She thinks if I get her 15 Blue Mushroom Caps and 15 Horny Mushroom Caps, her father will change his mind.

name: The Old Snail
log: The book is about the Oldest Snail in Maple World and its Rainbow-colored Snail Shell. It looks like Pia is interested in the snail’s shell because it makes wishes come true. Jay is the original owner of the book; he must know something about the author. Let’s go see him.

name: Hero of the Story
log: Took Jay’s advice and visited Mrs. Ming Ming to ask about Alloy, the author of The Snail Legend. She said her grandfather’s latest letter was about Wing, the Fairy of Ellinia, and suggested I go see Wing the Fairy.

name: Snail Hunt
log: Wing the Fairy not only knew about Alloy, but also knew of Mano, the snail with the Rainbow-colored Snail Shell. Wing offered to reveal Mano’s location on one condition: bring him some snail shells.

name: What I Learned About Snails
log: Wing the Fairy in Ellinia told me that Mano has been spotted in the thicket around the beach near Lith Harbor. Time to head back to Pia in Henesys.

name: A rainbow snail shell that makes wishes come true!?
log: Pia asked me to go to Thicket Around the Beach III, take out Mano, and bring back its Rainbow-colored Snail Shell. So you get to stay here while I do all the work for you again? Don't you think that's a bit much? Maybe I'll just keep the Rainbow-colored Snail Shell for myself!

name: [Event] A New Adventure Awaits
log: Deliver Betty's research report to Cherry, the sailor who voyages to and from Ossyria. You can find her at Ellinia Station.

name: Maya of Henesys
log: A girl named Maya in Henesys Townstreet has been ill for a long time. It seems like she hasn't been able to live a normal life at all, so I agreed to do what I could to help. Weird Medicine... What a strange name! She told me that it helps improve her health, at least a little bit... I should go to Lith Harbor and see this guy, Teo.

name: Finding Sophia
log: I met Sophia. To make the Sparkling Rock, she said she needs Arcon's Blood.

name: Making a Sparkling Rock
log: Sophia told me that Manji has some Arcon's Blood, a key ingredient in making a Sparkling Rock.

name: Arcon's Blood?
log: Manji asked me to defeat Zombie Mushrooms and gather Charm of the Undead in return for Arcon's Blood.

name: Getting Arcon's Blood
log: I brought the Charm of the Undead to Manji and finally got Arcon's Blood. I should hurry back to Sophia...

name: Making Sparkling Rock
log: Sophia was startled when she saw I had gotten Arcon's Blood, and she made me a Sparkling Rock with it. Now then, should I go back to Teo in Lith Harbor?

name: Delivering the Weird Medicine
log: I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the Weird Medicine. Hopefully it'll help her get better. As a sign of thanks, Maya gave me some Mesos and a Brown Bamboo Hat. The hat... I mean, it looked like it'd protect me from the sun, but it was so old and raggedy... And when I put it on, it made this weird noise... It felt like insects were moving around inside it... Am I going to be okay?

name: Proof of Companionship
log: Lakelis in Kerning City asked me to challenge the party quest First Time Together and defeat King Slime inside. The party quest must be attempted by a party of four adventurers, all level 21 or higher. Once all members are ready, the party leader can speak to Lakelis to start the party quest. Better start looking for some friends to join me.

name: Dr. Faymus's Request
log: I delivered what Dr. Faymus asked for and got a bunch of White Potions in return. I wonder what kind of potion Dr. Faymus will make using those materials. Return to Nella for another gig.

name: Chris's Request
log: I delivered what Chris asked for and got some refined iron and bronze in return. Chris can finally sleep well with his new pillow. Return to Nella for another gig.

name: Cutthroat Manny's Request
log: I delivered what Cutthroat Manny asked for and got a pair of shoes in return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. After helping out the people in this town, I feel like I've really become close with them!

name: Stranger's Request
log: I met Jane Doe inside the Niora Hospital in Kerning City. Jane Doe needs to take off her bandages to see the results of her surgery, but there's no mirror in the nearly abandoned building. Jane Doe asked me to defeat 40 Stirges and collect 20 Broken Mirror Glasss, so she could take a look at herself...

name: Stranger's Identity
log: Jane Doe, whom I met in the Niora Hospital was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't be revived with the Charm of the Undead. It seemed, deep down, that she already knew that, though... I really hope she finds peace.

name: Camila's Gem
log: I met Camila in Henesys, and, because of her timid disposition, she needs me to deliver Sparkling Glass Marble to Utah for her. I can get to Utah's Pig Farm through The Forest East of Henesys...

name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
log: I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader, in front of the Sleepywood Hotel. He appears to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He recently discovered a place that grows the last herb he needs for a medicine he's been working on... He asked me to go deep in the forest and grab the Pink Anthurium. It's made of green grass and a small pink flower... I need to make sure I get him the same exact one. Shane from Ellinia can take me to the right place.

name: A Blacksmith in My Own Right!
log: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and Zombie Mushrooms, then create an Orihalcon Ingot and a Gold Ingot and bring them back to him.

name: A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!
log: Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat Iron Hogs and craft 1 Monkey Wrench to bring back to him.

name: A Tailor in My Own Right!
log: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Wild Boars and craft 1 Red Starry Bandana to bring back to him.

name: A Carpenter in My Own Right!
log: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and craft The Red Relaxer to bring back to him.

name: A Leatherworker in My Own Right!
log: Impressed by my growth, the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City suggested that I showcase what I'm capable of. I need to defeat Wild Boars and craft 1 Red Chair, then bring it back.

name: An Arcforger in My Own Right!
log: The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I need to defeat Horny Mushrooms and craft 1 Topaz to bring back to him.

name: [Event] The Marks We Leave Behind
log: Jay found a tattered adventure log in the house study, and cannot make head or tail of it. The middle pages are gone, but the last page still reads: "Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it." A line like that only gets written down over a treasure worth hiding. Go and talk to Jay.

name: [Event] The First Mark
hint: Find the secluded shore hidden somewhere on Victoria Island.
log: The first page of the Adventurer's Journal reads: "Where the sea meets a shore guarded by little snouts."\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] The Second Mark
hint: Search for an unfamiliar dwelling and investigate the area around it.
log: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 2 reads: "I spent one night beneath a stranger's roof."\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] The Third Mark
hint: Search the high branches deep in the ancient woods.
log: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 3 reads: "The forest remembers what the traveler forgets."\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] The Fourth Mark
hint: Search the alleyways for the next trail.
log: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 4 reads: "Where shadows gather, leave no coin unturned."\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] The Fifth Mark
hint: Track down the wild beasts in the rocky lands.
log: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 5 reads: "Beyond the familiar path, the wild ones roam."\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Event] The Final Mark
hint: Follow the footsteps underground to the final treasure.
log: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 6 reads: "Beneath the earth, even the smallest footsteps may lead the way."\r Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Concern
log: Mrs. Ming Ming mentioned that although the town festival was a huge success, Chief Stan hasn't been feeling quite like himself lately. She asked for help finding a way to cheer him up, suggesting that Jay, who is well-versed in ancient history, might know something. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Chief Stan's Past
log: Jay of Henesys mentioned that Chief Stan was an adventurer who traveled the world in the past, and suggested that if he could find the Old Chief Stan's Hammer lost long ago when he was young, he might regain his energy. I should inform Mrs. Ming Ming of this information. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Chief Stan's Hammer
log: Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to look for the Old Chief Stan's Hammer for Chief Stan. Will I be able to find it while hunting Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel? Nothing is certain, but if I ever get the chance to go to the Ant Tunnel, I should look for it. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Memories of Youth
log: Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to deliver the freshly polished Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan. She seems a bit cautious about handing it over herself.

name: Regained Vitality
log: Chief Stan of Henesys asked me to tell Mrs. Ming Ming that he is sorry and grateful. However, the news that he has regained his vitality will likely be what makes her happiest. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Lost Thank-You
log: Alex of Kerning City said that even though he'd made up with his father, he'd already gotten used to his free life in Kerning City, so he was hesitant about going back home. In the meantime, he wanted to repay the people who'd helped him back when he first arrived in Kerning City and had such a rough time of it, so he'd prepared some gifts for them — but he'd gone and lost them in the marshland, and asked me to help him get them back. Let's defeat Ligator in the marshland near Kerning City and find Alex's Gift Sack. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Too Shy to Say It Himself
log: Alex of Kerning City asked me to deliver his gift to Nella for him. Apparently, he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Nella's Old Memory
log: Nella of Kerning City seemed touched by Alex's gift. I should go let Alex know. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: One More Debt to Repay
log: Alex of Kerning City asked me to deliver his gift to JM From tha Streetz. Apparently he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Not Ready to Go Home Yet
log: JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City accepted Alex's gift with an air of indifference, but seemed secretly pleased deep down. I should go let Alex know. \r Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: The Filing Error
log: Lyn the Librarian asked me to recover 25 Torn Ledger Pages the fairies took, then have Chief Stan in Henesys stamp the cover. I can probably find fairies in Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VI, Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VII, or Someone Else's House.

name: Chief Stan's Signature
log: Chief Stan made out one word in the damaged pages. He sent me to Manji in Perion.

name: Repairing the Book
log: Manji thought Chrishrama in Sleepywood might be able to repair the pages.

name: The Faded Ink
log: Chrishrama rebound the ledger but couldn't restore one long entry. He sent me to the Hotel Receptionist, who keeps records of her own.

name: The Dark Lord's Signature
log: Dark Lord found his own name in the ledger and didn't care for it. He couldn't tell me much, but he sent me to Alex on the rooftops.

name: We Hold Your Place
log: Grendel the Really Old read the whole entry and couldn't make sense of it. He told me to take the ledger back up to Lyn the Librarian and ask her what it means.

name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
log: Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia told me that she lost Arwen's Glass Shoe a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flames stole it! Fairies tend to obsess over glimmering, shiny objects, so she obviously wants it back... Time to go hunt some boars near Perion.

name: Maya's First Collection
log: I got a request from Maya of Henesys, who likes collecting all kinds of items. She wants 20 of each of the following: Orange Mushroom Cap, Green Mushroom Cap, Blue Mushroom Cap, and Horny Mushroom Cap. It looks like I can get all of these from hunting monsters around the prairie...

name: Maya's Second Collection
log: I got everything Maya asked for. Please don't tell me she wanted all of it for free...

name: The Warrior's Next Journey
log: Does Dances with Balrog of Perion have even greater lessons to teach me?

name: Finding the Instructor
log: Perion's Dances with Balrog gave me a letter to deliver to the Warrior Job Instructor, who I should be able to find somewhere in West Rocky Mountain IV. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.

name: Test of Qualification
log: The Warrior Job Instructor at West Rocky Mountain IV gave me my mission: enter a hidden area, defeat the monsters there, and collect Black Marbles.

name: Proof of Qualification
log: I received The Proof of a Hero for successfully passing the Warrior Job Instructor's test. I should return to Dances with Balrog in Perion now.

name: The Magician's Next Journey
log: Does Grendel the Really Old of Ellinia have even greater lessons to teach me?

name: Finding the Instructor
log: Ellinia's Grendel the Really Old gave me a letter to deliver to the Magician Job Instructor, who I should be able to find somewhere in The Forest North of Ellinia. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.

name: Test of Qualification
log: The Magician Job Instructor at The Forest North of Ellinia gave me my mission: enter a hidden area, defeat the monsters there, and collect Black Marbles.

name: Proof of Qualification
log: I received The Proof of a Hero for successfully passing the Magician Job Instructor's test. I should return to Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia now.

name: The Bowman's Next Journey
log: Does Athena Pierce of Henesys have even greater lessons to teach me?

name: Finding the Instructor
log: Henesys's Athena Pierce gave me a letter to deliver it to the Bowman Job Instructor, who I should be able to find somewhere on The Road to the Dungeon. She said I'd learn the rest of the details there.

name: Test of Qualification
log: The Bowman Job Instructor on The Road to the Dungeon gave me my mission: enter a hidden area, defeat the monsters there, and collect Black Marbles.

name: Proof of Qualification
log: I received The Proof of a Hero for successfully passing the Bowman Job Instructor's test. I should return to Athena Pierce in Henesys now.

name: The Thief's Next Journey
log: Does Dark Lord of Kerning City have even greater lessons to teach me?

name: Finding the Instructor
log: Kerning City's Dark Lord gave me a letter to deliver to the Thief Job Instructor, who I should be able to find somewhere at the Construction Site North of Kerning City. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.

name: Test of Qualification
log: The Thief Job Instructor at Construction Site North of Kerning City gave me my mission: enter a hidden area, defeat the monsters there, and collect Black Marbles.

name: Proof of Qualification
log: I received The Proof of a Hero for successfully passing the Thief Job Instructor's test. I should return to Dark Lord in Kerning City now.

name: Icarus's Hang Glider
log: I went to meet Icarus on top of a building in Kerning City. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.

name: Icarus and the Balloon
log: Icarus failed to build a working hang glider, and, persistent in his never-ending quest for flight, is now attempting to create a flying balloon. This seems just as preposterous as his last idea, but I don't think I can stop him, so I might as well help him. To make the flying balloon, he needs 50 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouches. For his sake, I really hope this works...

name: A Clue to the Secret Book
log: I met an old, balding man named Mr. Wetbottom in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son?? He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. \r Mr. Wetbottom told me that his son, Ronnie, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around Ellinia. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in this book of his...???

name: Hungry Ronnie
log: I brought a bunch of Lupin's Bananas for the hungry Ronnie. But it looked like he still wanted to eat more...

name: Still Hungry Ronnie
log: I went to see Rina of Henesys to help feed the hungry Ronnie.

name: Secret to Unagi Special
log: I brought Rina everything needed to make Rina's Unagi Special.

name: Rina's Unagi Special
log: I brought Rina's Unagi Special to Ronnie. That kid sure seemed to enjoy it!

name: Thirsty Ronnie
log: I went to see Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia to help quench Ronnie's thirst.

name: Cold Milk
log: I brought a Diamond to Rowen the Fairy.

name: Satisfied Ronnie
log: I brought the Fresh Milk to Ronnie. Phew, I guess he's too full to eat any more now!

name: Returned Secret Book
log: I got Mr. Wetbottom the precious Secret Book that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about Ronnie at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... Well, it'd be best for Ronnie to stay with the fairies, right? Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing this cumbersome armor in the sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and relax at the sauna...

name: Truth of the Rumor
log: During the excavation, Doctor Winston said he heard a rumor about a very old tree living in Perion. However, he had no clue on what kind of tree it was, or where exactly it was located. That's why he's asked me to visit Perion village to collect information on this particular tree. Shall I start by visiting Blackbull?

name: Truth of the Rumor-Blackbull
log: Ayan lived in Perion for a long time. Let's go ask about the rumor.

name: Truth of the Rumor-Manji
log: Manji has been training at Perion for a long time. Let's go and ask about the rumor.

name: Truth of the Rumor- Dances with Balrog
log: Let's ask elder Dances with Balrog in Perion about the rumor.

name: Truth of the Rumor-Betty
log: Let's ask botanist Betty in Ellinia about the rumor.

name: A Report for the Doctor
log: Botanist Betty in Ellinia suggested that I take all the information I've gathered so far to Archaeologist Winston in East Rocky Mountain II.

name: Stump Research
log: Doctor Winston thought the reason why all the stumps in Perion were dry was due to Stumpy. To prove his theory, he wanted to do research on the Stumps' Very Dry Branch.

name: Monstrous Tree Stumpy
log: Visited Doctor Winston again. He says Stumpy seems to take all the nutrients from Perion. He also added that if this continues, Perion would become a wasteland devoid of life. The Stumpy must be eliminated.

name: [Construction Site B1] Shumi's Lost Coin
log: I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She's devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloths picked it up when she dropped it, and that I might find them at Construction Site B1, deep in the subway station... I guess I should head there first...

name: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
log: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a Stirge flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again...? Can I just pay her rent for her at this point? Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...

name: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
log: I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she was doing a favor for JM From tha Streetz and getting some Screws for him. But the Sack of Cash he gave her to buy them fell out of her pocket while she was walking around in the subway, and she lost it. She said it fell deep into the subway station, to Construction Site B3.

name: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls
log: I ran into Rowen the Fairy again, who had given me Fresh Milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son, last time. Back then, she seemed guarded, but now, she's accepted me as Ronnie's friend... \r \r Rowen the Fairy is an assistant for the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old. She's concerned about the Cursed Dolls: evil dolls he'd made with black magic, a long, long time ago. While they'd been sealed for quite some time, a bunch of Lupins recently stole them and got away. The Lupins have since become zombies and are destroying the forest. To take back the forest, someone needs to eliminate the Zombie Lupins and take the Cursed Dolls away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect 50 Cursed Dolls, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...

name: Collecting 70 Cursed Dolls
log: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in the forest near Ellinia and collected all 70 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...

name: Collecting 100 Cursed Dolls
log: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 100 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very rare ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...

name: Collecting 150 Cursed Dolls
log: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 150 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me a scroll for gloves. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...

name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
log: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 200 Cursed Dolls for Rowen the Fairy. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I collected so many dolls for her, but it seemed like the Zombie Lupins aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... I wonder what was going on. However, it seemed that the fairies might not have as much animosity toward humans now... That's a good thing, at least.

name: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
log: Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect 10 Coconuts. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right?

name: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
log: I have to prepare enough ingredients for 15 people and bring them to Riel in Florina Beach.

name: Special Taste of Florina Beach III
log: I have to bring enough ingredients for 30 people to Riel in Florina Beach.

name: Special Taste of Florina Beach IV
log: I need to collect ingredients that will help further cultivate the special taste of Florina Beach: 10 Coconuts, 10 Lorang Claws, 10 Clang Claws, and 10 Lupin's Bananas. Will Valen's new recipe succeed?

name: A Gift for Pia
log: I met Camila in Henesys, and it looks like she's fretting over a birthday present for yet another friend of hers in town, Pia. The trouble is, Pia is quite picky about her tastes, so Camila asked me to go find out what she'd like to receive. I hear I can find Pia over at Henesys Park. \r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Pia's Mischievous Wish
log: I met Pia at Henesys Park, and with a mischievous look on her face, she said what she'd really like as a birthday present is a Sparkling Glass Marble. The trouble is, that's the very same precious item Camila once gave to Utah as a birthday present... I'd better head back to Camila first. \r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Materials for a Special Marble
log: It looks like Camila has decided to make a prettier, sturdier marble for Pia. For Camila's sake, let's head down into the Kerning City subway or the depths of the Ant Tunnel, defeat some Jr. Boogie 1 or Jr. Boogie 2, and gather Jr. Boogie Horn.�\r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Marble Made With Care
log: Camila asked me to deliver the birthday present to Pia on her behalf. Since it isn't the exact item Pia said she wanted, Camila seems quite worried about it. Still, it must've just been my imagination that Pia seemed to be thinking about Utah.�\r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Promise Between Three Friends
log: When I met Pia at Henesys Park, it turned out she was just a girl who wasn't very good at being honest about her feelings. Too embarrassed, or something like that. Still, somehow I think I understand how she feels. Pia asked me to go tell Camila that the two of them should visit Utah's farm together sometime. Those two are pretty cute, aren't they?�\r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Worn Bandages
log: Jane Doe knew full well she wasn't among the living anymore, and yet she refused to accept it. Worried that Dr. Niora might never come back, she said she'd have to change her own bandages, and asked me to defeat Jr. Wraith and gather Tablecloth for her. \r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Torn Letter
log: Jane Doe of Niora Hospital said she simply couldn't bring herself to change her own bandages, and asked me to go find Dr. Niora. She said she'd found part of a letter Roxy had sent to Dr. Niora, and thought Roxy might know something about her whereabouts. I should go see Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center. \r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Once a Renowned Doctor
log: Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center told me what she knew. According to her, Niora was once a fairly well-known doctor here in Kerning City, but one day, after an accident at his hospital took the life of a young girl, he vanished from the city. She said she didn't know where Niora had gone, but suggested I go see Nella if I wanted to learn more. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: The Price of Information
log: Nella of Kerning City said she couldn't just hand over information for free, but promised to tell me what she knew if I took care of a job request that had just come in. Let's gather Fairy's Tentacles for her. \r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Truth Finally Known
log: I was able to learn a great deal from Nella. Niora was a doctor of considerable skill, but in the course of practicing medicine, he'd carried out all sorts of experiments on his patients, and patients' conditions had begun worsening at his hospital with increasing frequency. Then, one day, a young girl lost her life — and that was what finally brought Niora under Dark Lord's investigation. He was banished from the city and never returned. Which would mean that girl was... I suppose I'd better go see Jane Doe again. \r Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.

name: First Material Delivery for Building a New House
log: Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked me for help gathering materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road soon. I can collect 30 Horny Mushroom Caps and 30 Curse Eye Tails by hunting Horny Mushrooms and Curse Eyes...

name: Second Material Delivery for Building a New House
log: Ronnie asked me to collect 30 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and Tablecloths by taking down 50 Bubblings and 50 Jr. Wraiths. I should be able to get them from the monsters living in the Kerning City subway. That sounds like it'll be no problem!

name: Third Material Delivery for Building a New House
log: Ronnie asked me to hunt 50 Fire Boars and 50 Copper Drakes and collect 30 Fire Boar's Tooth and 30 Drake Skull. I should be able to get them from the monsters around Perion. Things are starting to get a bit tricky...

name: Last Material Delivery for Building a New House
log: Ronnie asked me for help one last time. This time, he wants me to get 30 Cold Eye Tails, 10 Dragon Skins, and 1 Diamond by taking down Cold Eyes and Drakes. I guess I can do it, but hunting down in the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel... This is way too hard!!

name: Pia's Present For a Friend
log: I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearing Pia at the Henesys Park. Last time I saw her, I took care of some Blue Mushrooms for her. This time, she wants to make a claw as a present for a friend in Ellinia, who's embarking on an adventure soon. The claw she wants to make requires 15 Silver Ingots, 30 Dragon Skins, and 30 Screws... If I get her all these... will I be richly rewarded?

name: Looking for the Red Cape
log: Pia also asked me to retrieve the Red Cape that Rina in Henesys borrowed, to give it to her friend too. She'll give me something nice if I bring it back to her.

name: What Pia Borrowed
log: I went to see Rina in Henesys, and she told me she actually took that red cape because Pia also hasn't returned some items that she borrowed. She says that she'll return the cape when she gets her things back... The items are 1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes.

name: Pia's Gift
log: I finally got my hands on the Red Cape that Pia asked for. Now, I just need to bring it back to her.

name: Jane's First Challenge
log: Last time, I got Jane some mushroom caps to help convince her dad to let her travel. Apparently, it didn't work. Now, she has a new dream: she wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. She told me she needed certain materials to pursue her dreams... and I already knew exactly what she was going to ask for. She wants me to collect 1 Pure Water, 25 Drake Skull, and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes by defeating monsters, so she can make some Elixirs.

name: Jane's Second Challenge
log: This time, Jane promised to make me an even better item than last time, but she needs me to defeat some monsters and gather 1 Mushmom Spore, 3 vials of Drake's Blood, 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes, and 25 Malady's Experimental Frogs. She claimed that she'll be able to use these ingredients to make a more powerful elixir...

name: Jane's Final Challenge
log: For this last experiment, Jane promised to make me a mysterious scroll. For that, she needs 1 Moon Rock, 20 Dragon Skins, and 10 vials of Sap of Ancient Tree. Maybe I should ask the fairies in Ellinia for the Moon Rock...

name: Matters of the Heart
log: I need to deliver the Scorched Arcon Scroll to Jaime the Wandering Explorer in a map to see if he can explain the living malice.

name: A Memory of Iron
log: Jaime the Wandering Explorer discovered the soil is skewed by rusted iron from Tristan's ancient battle with the Balrog. I must defeat 50 Echopuss to clear the toxic air.

name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
log: I met with Luke at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then was completely gone... because he and his mom drank it all... Ah, well. Luke said he was over the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, Silas Irons of Perion is asking for 1 Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, 30 Drake Skulls, 20 Dragon Skins, and 20 Screws! He wants me to gather them for him... The fairies of Ellinia might know something about the Black Feather.

name: In search of Wing the Fairy
log: Icarus's flying balloon didn't work out, but his quest for flight continues. This time, he wants to deviate from a scientific approach and opt for a magical one. He asked me to go see his best friend, Wing the Fairy, in Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently, Wing the Fairy knows how to make Flying Medicine... I'll need to go see him in Ellinia, for Icarus's sake.

name: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
log: I met Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, and he REALLY doesn't seem to like people. As a whole. How did he and Icarus become best friends in the first place? Anyway, in order to make the Flying Medicine, he needs 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leafs. That's really all it takes to fly?

name: Delivering the Flying Medicine
log: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia asked me to deliver the Flying Medicine to Icarus. So this little bottle can make someone fly? I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.

name: Maya's Third Collection
log: I got everything Maya asked for. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??

name: Maya's Last Collection
log: Maya asked me to gather 1 Diamond, 50 Stone Golem Rubble, and 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble. I can get them by defeating monsters at the Golem's Temple, which is on the way from Henesys to the dungeon... but this is getting way too hard!

name: An Unknown Savior
log: Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, said that a while back, she wandered a bit further from town than usual to pick some delicious mushrooms, and stumbled upon a giant mushroom monster that put her in grave danger — until a warrior appeared out of nowhere and saved her. She wants to track him down and repay his kindness, but he vanished the moment he'd saved her, and she's had no way of finding him since. She's hoping I can help her find some clue. To find any leads, I should probably start by heading to the place where it all happened. It seems I need to look for the Giant Mushroom somewhere at Someone Else's House in Henesys. I suppose I'll have to take it down? \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Name on a Note
log: From Torn Note, which I obtained after defeating Mushmom, the one who'd attacked Maya, I picked up two leads: Ellinia and Chrishrama. I think it'd be best to head to Sleepywood first and go hear what Chrishrama has to say. \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Price to Pay
log: Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, wouldn't say a word, insisting that person wouldn't want to be known — but worn down by my persistent pleading, he reluctantly set one condition. That condition was for me to bring him Drake Skull for his research. It seems I should be able to get Drake Skulls by defeating Copper Drakes, found far off from Perion, or Drakes deep within the Ant Tunnel. \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Man Atoning
log: Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, told me to go find a man standing at the top of Perion. He clearly seems to know more than he's letting on, but for now he seems to be holding his tongue. Let's go find that warrior at Perion.� \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Name Never Given
log: When I told Manji of Perion that Maya was looking for the one who'd saved her life, he seemed to waver for a moment — but then asked me to keep his secret, saying he didn't want her to know who he was. I wonder what I should tell Maya when I go back to her... \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Quiet Line of Work
log: Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site, unlike his brother Manji, a renowned swordsman, had secretly been doing exorcism work, hunting down evil spirits. He said he could sense the power of a strong evil spirit somewhere around Kerning City, and suggested that while he investigated elsewhere, I go investigate deep within the subway. If I ran into any Wraiths down there, it sounded like I'd need to defeat them all. \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Another Lead
log: Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site said he could still sense the power of a strong evil spirit, and that something didn't seem right. Could it be that even after defeating all those evil spirits in the Kerning City subway, it still wasn't enough? Just as Chun Ji suggested, I should go talk to Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center to get more information. \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Name She Couldn't Say
log: Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center couldn't hide the seriousness on her face when I mentioned that Chun Ji had been sensing a powerful evil spirit somewhere in Kerning City. After thinking it over for a while, she said the only one she could think of was the girl at Niora Hospital, and asked me to go check on Jane Doe. Something about this doesn't sit right with me... \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: An Old Grudge
log: Jane Doe at Niora Hospital said there was a hidden passage on the first floor of Niora Hospital, and that she could sense an unusually powerful force coming from somewhere deep inside it, suggesting I go take a look. To think a passage had been hidden away in a place like that... There might be something dangerous down there, so I'd better be well prepared before investigating, and then head back to Roxy. \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: An Unresolved Question
log: Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center seemed genuinely glad, deep down, that the powerful evil spirit had turned out to be Shade, and not Jane Doe. Still, why had Shade come to hold such deep resentment, and just what had happened in that marshland connected to Niora Hospital? Finding the answers to all of this doesn't seem like it'll be easy. It's about time I headed back to Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site. \r Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Building a New House For Blackbull
log: I ran into Blackbull again, the guy whose house I'd helped fix before. He was surprised at how strong I'd gotten and asked me for another favor, a bit harder than the last one. His cousins from Henesys are trying to move to Perion, so he needs to build a new house for them! The materials he needs for this project are 100 Stone Golem Rubbles, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood, and Blackbull's Deed to the Land. His son had the deed when it was stolen by Curse Eyes near Sleepywood... Hmmm... I should look for ones wandering around in the Deep Forest...

name: Taking Out the Alligators 1
log: I spoke with Ayan in Perion. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of Ligators. She's worried about the sudden surge of Ligators, and other alligator monsters, taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.

name: Taking Out the Alligators 2
log: I went to see Ayan, and she was in a panic. She had been walking around the swamp one day, when she ran into an even bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators, Crocos. She immediately turned and ran back to Perion. She'd been waiting for me to come by since then, hoping I could help her. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins.

name: Old Gladius
log: I visited Manji again, whom I'd first met in Perion, when making the medicine for Maya of Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I've become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who ended up dying in Manji's place. Ever since then, Manji has held onto Tristan's sword. However, the blade was so corrupted by Balrog that it's almost too worn down to even be called a sword anymore... Manji handed me the Old Gladius that he'd held onto all these years and asked me to reawaken its true form. Once fully awakened, it will become the Hero's Gladius. Manji told me to begin with seeking out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.

name: Reawakening the Gladius
log: I showed Chrishrama Manji's Old Gladius, and he revealed that he was the sword's creator. He needs 1 Star Rock, 1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flaming Feather to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to Mike in Perion Dungeon Entrance to get started.

name: Hero's Gladius
log: With Chrishrama's help, I awakened the Old Gladius, entrusted to me by Manji, into the Hero's Gladius. All that remains now is to return the sword to Manji.

name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
log: I ran into Sabitrama in front of the Sleepywood Hotel again, the one I helped get herbs for before. This time, he found a new place with a different important herb that he needs for another type of medicine he's working on. He asked me to go back to the forest and grab a Double-Rooted Red Ginseng for him. It has a reddish root split in two... I should make sure I grab the same exact one once I get to the top. I guess that means I have to go back to Shane in Ellinia...

name: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
log: Daniel the Scholar, a friendly mediator for the fairies, explained that the living malice Caligo has consumed the Arcon. To hide the fairies' home from Caligo's gaze, he needs to cast an invisible Stasis Seal. I must gather 30 Cursed Dolls and 20 Duskmander Tails from the deeper chambers.

name: The Sage's Burden
log: I must travel back up to the Magic Library and deliver the truth to Grendel the Really Old before the Sages are caught completely off guard.

name: Embers in the Garden
log: Tamya says Duskmanders keep crawling up from a map toward her campfire. Defeat 60 Duskmanders so the camp stays safe.

name: Words Nobody Taught
log: Tamya can't read her grandmother's journal. It's written in the old fairy script. Take the Hearthkeeper's Journal to Daniel the Scholar in a map.

name: Boughs for the Lanterns
log: For the Lantern Rite, the hearthkeepers built lantern frames from boughs the Myewoods gave freely. Collect 30 Giant Tree's Boughs from Myewoods and bring them to Jaime the Wandering Explorer in a map. He knows the way to the old tomb.

name: Charms Gone Gray
log: The Rotten Mushrooms have scattered the old name-charms all over the deep tunnels. Collect 30 Decayed Charms from them in a map and a map, and bring them to Jaime the Wandering Explorer.

name: The Dilapidated Tomb
log: Jaime the Wandering Explorer wants to return the other charms to a map. Defeat 60 Sporewoods there so he can work safely, then take the Elda's Name-Charm to Daniel the Scholar in a map so he can read it.

name: The Last Lantern
log: Bring Elda's Last Message back to Tamya in a map.

name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor
log: It seems Athena Pierce, who leads the town, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away.� \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Box Hidden Long Ago
log: Athena Pierce of Henesys said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a Citizen of Honor, but that she'd give it to me if I could do her one favor first. She told me that a long, long time ago, she'd hidden a small box containing a bow somewhere in the Golem's Temple, but when she recently went to retrieve it, it was gone — and she asked me to go find that box for her. I wonder if Stone Golem or Dark Stone Golem out there might have it. \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Worn-Out Bow
log: Inside Athena Pierce's box was a small, old bow. But it had fallen apart after all that time, and Athena Pierce said Vicious should be able to fix it. It seems I should head to Vicious at Henesys Market and show them the bow. Still, if this bow is centuries old, just how many long years has Athena Pierce been alive for?� \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Craftsman's Touch
log: Vicious said the Broken Wooden Bow is made from a rare wood hardly ever found on Victoria Island, and asked me to gather Dragon Skin and Fragment of Magic as materials to repair the bow. It seems Dragon Skin can be obtained from Copper Drake, Drake, and Red Drake, while Fragment of Magic can be obtained from monsters imbued with magical energy, such as Malady, Stone Golem, and Dark Stone Golem.� \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Memory Restored
log: Vicious of Henesys Market, true to his reputation as the town's finest craftsman, repaired Athena Pierce's bow to perfection. All that's left now is to bring this Repaired Wooden Bow back to Athena Pierce.� \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor
log: It seems Dark Lord, the city's hidden leader, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away. \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: A Missing Comrade
log: Dark Lord of Kerning City said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a Citizen of Honor, but that he'd give it to me once I completed one task. Dark Lord told me that long ago, not long after he'd first become the Dark Lord, a comrade of his had been kidnapped by a rival faction seeking to seize control of the city, and he entrusted me with the task of finding some clue to his whereabouts. He said the faction most likely responsible for the kidnapping had their hideout deep in the marshland, so I might be able to turn up a clue by defeating Croco there. \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: An Unbreakable Code
log: Dark Lord at Thieves' Hideout said there was someone who could decipher Encrypted Document, and told me to seek out an expert living somewhere deep in the marshland. It sounded like I could find him in a small cabin at Monkey Swamp III. \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: What It Takes
log: Slade at The Hermit's Cabin said Encrypted Document had been intricately sealed with magical power, and that deciphering it would require something called Ink of Truth. He said Malady near Ellinia had it, so it sounded like I'd need to defeat them to get my hands on it. \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: The Weight of Truth
log: Slade at The Hermit's Cabin succeeded in deciphering Encrypted Document using Ink of Truth. But the look on Slade's face darkened as he read over the deciphered document... Anyway, I'd better bring this to Dark Lord at Kerning City right away. \r Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.

name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket
log: I met a fisherman named John in Lith Harbor. He wants to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary and asked if I could get him 10 Pink Violas for her. According to him, a Mysterious Statue can take me to the flower's location. Sleepywood... Sleepywood?!?!?! That's FAR!!!

name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Present
log: I ran into John the fisherman again in Lith Harbor. This time, he wants to get his wife Blue Violas for her birthday and asked me to get 20 Blue Violas for him. Apparently, the scent of Blue Violas lasts for over 500 years... John told me that they can be found in the same place as last time, the Mysterious Statue. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??

name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Last Present
log: I ran into John the fisherman again in Lith Harbor. This time, he told me his mother passed away recently, and he wants to get some White Violas for her. He asked me to get 30 White Violas for him. Apparently, the scent of White Violas lasts over 1,000 years... and, according to John, they can ALSO be found in the Mysterious Statue. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??
